name: Empty database init check
command:
set -euo pipefail
name=portal-init-check-$$
cleanup(){ docker rm -f "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT
docker run --rm -d --name "$name" -e POSTGRES_USER=verify -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=verify -e POSTGRES_DB=portal_hotel -p 55432:5432 postgres:16 >/dev/null
for i in $(seq 1 30); do docker exec "$name" pg_isready -U verify -d portal_hotel >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done
DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_PORT=55432 DB_USER=verify DB_PASSWORD=verify DB_NAME=portal_hotel JWT_SECRET=01234567890123456789012345678901 node --import tsx --input-type=module -e 'import { initializeDatabase } from "./src/db/init.ts"; import { pool } from "./src/db/client.ts"; await initializeDatabase(); await initializeDatabase(); const r=await pool.query("SELECT count(*)::int AS tables FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = current_schema() AND tablename IN (\"users\",\"reservations\",\"reservation_events\",\"reservation_payments\")"); console.log(`empty_db_initialize: passed (${r.rows[0].tables} tables)`); await pool.end();'
description: Exercise idempotent schema initialization twice against a fresh ephemeral PostgreSQL container.
